description.value: Family-run lakeside resort 15 km north of Boston Bar in the Fraser Canyon, with wooded and lakeside campsites beside a crystal-clear lake, a sandy beach, flush washrooms, and pay showers; access is 1.5 km of gravel climbing a mountainside — manageable for cars but a stiff push for a loaded bike.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Primary evidence is the fetched website content across five subpages; OSM supplies location and category tags. The amenities page and campsites page provide the strongest evidence for optional amenities: showers (coin-operated, confirmed twice), laundry (confirmed on /campsites), potable water (FAQ confirms Interior Health weekly testing), ice (amenities page), reservations (online booking system evident), and an on-site general store confirming food availability. No mention of hiker/biker-specific sites, cyclist discounts, e-bike charging, tools, or pump anywhere on the site. The FAQ flags a 1.5km uphill gravel access road which is a material concern for loaded touring cyclists.
concerns: OSM phone field is empty; phone numbers sourced from website only (local: 604-867-9246, toll-free: 1-877-867-9246 — a second local number 604-763-1804 appears in the 2026 bookings notice, possible updated number worth monitoring).
Access road is approximately 1.5km of uphill gravel per FAQ — may be difficult for heavily loaded touring bikes.

Website mailing address (Box 385, Boston Bar, BC V0K 1C0) differs from OSM street address (63452 Blue Lake Road); physical address not explicitly stated on website so OSM street address is unconfirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate, actively operating campground with confirmed amenities (showers, laundry, potable water, food store) useful to touring cyclists on the Fraser Canyon route; open year-round.
enrichment_extras.notes: Free WiFi available at the General Store. Resort is 15km north of Boston Bar via a gravel road; cyclists should be aware of the mountain approach.

wow_evidence: Family-run lakeside resort…with wooded and lakeside campsites beside a crystal-clear lake, a sandy beach, flush washrooms, and pay showers
